verdict.rationale: Simular documents a Sai API for driving device control from a developer's own code. It has REST endpoints to send tasks, stream progress events, and answer approval requests, plus a Python SDK (`pip install sai-sdk`) and simulang-js/CLI tooling, so embedding is directly supported. The evidence for each of these is a single brief line, though, and no published OpenAPI spec was found. missing for 10: a machine-readable API spec (the OpenAPI probes all returned 404), in-depth SDK reference documentation beyond install and endpoint summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration of the integration, and documented API control of BYOD/local devices rather than only cloud Windows computers.
